verdicts.reason: A: headline wraps and leaves 'last' orphaned, subcopy is crushed into a narrow 6-line column, and the logo is a nearly invisible speck at the far left. Still, A keeps a sensible left-to-right order (brand, sale ribbon, product, headline, CTA) and the ribbon stays readable. B: legal fine print opens the banner at far left, which inverts the hierarchy. The 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon is shrunk to an illegible sticker crammed against the end of the subcopy, the logo is a speck under the headline, and the headline nearly touches the CTA.
